personality.description: This person usually keeps a steady routine while staying open to a few new ideas or experiences when they seem worthwhile. They tend to be moderately organized and dependable, but they can adapt when plans change instead of insisting on rigid structure. In moral dilemmas, they typically stay calm, weigh the facts, and try to reach a fair decision; if a core principle is at stake, they will quietly but firmly defend their view. In group discussions, they speak in a measured, concise way, preferring small, focused conversations over large, highly energetic exchanges, and they listen carefully before contributing.
